func TestStructuredAssessmentRegularCourseHTTPFlows(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scenario := range structuredAssessmentScenarios() {
		t.Run(scenario.kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			runStructuredAssessmentHTTPFlow(t, scenario, false)
		})
	}
}

func TestStructuredAssessmentPracticeTaskScopedHTTPFlows(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scenario := range structuredAssessmentScenarios() {
		t.Run(scenario.kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			runStructuredAssessmentHTTPFlow(t, scenario, true)
		})
	}
}

func TestStructuredAssessmentPostgresScoringReadback(t *testing.T) {
	pool := getTestDBPool(t)
	defer pool.Close()

	answerRepo := pgadapter.StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	autoReviewRepo := pgadapter.AutoReviewRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	selectionRepo := pgadapter.TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	for _, scenario := range structuredAssessmentScenarios() {
		t.Run(scenario.kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			transport := &structuredCourseTransport{task: scenario.task, token: "internal-token"}
			courseClient := courseclient.Client{
				BaseURL:       "http://course.test",
				InternalToken: transport.token,
				HTTPClient:    &http.Client{Transport: transport},
			}
			studentID := uuid.NewString()
			publisher := newRecordPublisher()
			started, err := (answer.StartTaskAnswer{
				TaskProvider: courseClient,
				Answers:      answerRepo,
				Publisher:    publisher,
			}).Handle(context.Background(), answer.StartTaskAnswerInput{
				StudentID: studentID,
				TaskID:    scenario.task.ID,
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("start database-backed assessment: %v", err)
			}
			t.Cleanup(func() {
				_, _ = pool.Exec(context.Background(), `DELETE FROM task_test_answer_variant WHERE student_task_answer_id=$1`, started.AnswerID)
				cleanupTestDB(t, pool, started.AnswerID)
			})

			err = (answer.FinalValidation{
				Answers:         answerRepo,
				TaskTestAnswers: selectionRepo,
				TaskProvider:    courseClient,
				Publisher:       publisher,
				AutoReviews:     autoReviewRepo,
			}).Handle(context.Background(), started.AnswerID, scenario.correctPayload)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("finalize database-backed assessment: %v", err)
			}

			storedAnswer, err := answerRepo.GetByID(context.Background(), started.AnswerID)
			if err != nil || storedAnswer.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
				t.Fatalf("stored answer mismatch: answer=%+v err=%v", storedAnswer, err)
			}
			storedSelections, err := selectionRepo.ListForAnswer(context.Background(), started.AnswerID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("read stored selections: %v", err)
			}
			assertPersistedAssessmentSelections(t, scenario.kind, storedSelections, true)
			storedReview, err := autoReviewRepo.GetByAnswerID(context.Background(), started.AnswerID)
			if err != nil || !storedReview.Passed || storedReview.RawResult["source"] != "task_test" {
				t.Fatalf("stored review mismatch: review=%+v err=%v", storedReview, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

type structuredAssessmentScenario struct {
	kind             string
	task             *answer.TaskMetadata
	incorrectPayload json.RawMessage
	correctPayload   json.RawMessage
}

type structuredFlowFixture struct {
	integrationFixtures
	selections     *memoryAssessmentSelectionRepo
	practiceAccess *recordingPracticeAccess
}

func runStructuredAssessmentHTTPFlow(t *testing.T, scenario structuredAssessmentScenario, practiceScoped bool) {
	t.Helper()
	fixture := newStructuredFlowFixture(t, scenario.task, practiceScoped)
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	headers := authHeaders(studentID, "STUDENT")

	taskURL, startURL, submitURL := structuredAssessmentURLs(scenario.task.ID, practiceScoped)
	getTask := fixture.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodGet, taskURL, nil, headers)
	if getTask.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		body := readResponseBody(t, getTask)
		t.Fatalf("GET task returned %d: %s", getTask.StatusCode, body)
	}
	publicTask := readResponseBody(t, getTask)
	assertPublicAssessmentHasNoAnswerKey(t, publicTask)

	firstAnswerID := startStructuredAttempt(t, fixture.integrationFixtures, startURL, headers)
	firstSubmit := submitStructuredAttempt(t, fixture.integrationFixtures, submitURL(firstAnswerID), scenario.incorrectPayload, headers)
	if firstSubmit.Status != "FAILED" || firstSubmit.Review.Passed {
		t.Fatalf("incorrect %s submission result: %+v", scenario.kind, firstSubmit)
	}
	assertSafeStudentAssessmentPayload(t, firstSubmit.raw)
	if !bytes.Contains(firstSubmit.raw, []byte("ASSESSMENT_INCORRECT")) {
		t.Fatalf("failed assessment response has no generic error: %s", firstSubmit.raw)
	}

	assertPersistedAssessmentSelections(t, scenario.kind, fixture.selections.forAnswer(firstAnswerID), false)
	trustedReview, err := fixture.AutoReviews.GetByAnswerID(context.Background(), firstAnswerID)
	if err != nil || trustedReview.RawResult["items"] == nil {
		t.Fatalf("trusted diagnostics were not retained: review=%+v err=%v", trustedReview, err)
	}

	studentResultURLs := []string{
		fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/answers/%s", apiPrefix, scenario.task.ID, firstAnswerID),
		fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/answers/%s", apiPrefix, firstAnswerID),
		fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/results/%s", apiPrefix, firstAnswerID),
	}
	for _, resultURL := range studentResultURLs {
		response := fixture.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodGet, resultURL, nil, headers)
		if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
			body := readResponseBody(t, response)
			t.Fatalf("GET %s returned %d: %s", resultURL, response.StatusCode, body)
		}
		assertSafeStudentAssessmentPayload(t, readResponseBody(t, response))
	}

	secondAnswerID := startStructuredAttempt(t, fixture.integrationFixtures, startURL, headers)
	if secondAnswerID == firstAnswerID {
		t.Fatal("retry reused a finalized failed answer")
	}
	secondSubmit := submitStructuredAttempt(t, fixture.integrationFixtures, submitURL(secondAnswerID), scenario.correctPayload, headers)
	if secondSubmit.Status != "PASSED" || !secondSubmit.Review.Passed {
		t.Fatalf("correct %s submission result: %+v", scenario.kind, secondSubmit)
	}
	assertSafeStudentAssessmentPayload(t, secondSubmit.raw)
	assertPersistedAssessmentSelections(t, scenario.kind, fixture.selections.forAnswer(secondAnswerID), true)

	passedResult := fixture.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodGet, fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/results/%s", apiPrefix, secondAnswerID), nil, headers)
	if passedResult.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		body := readResponseBody(t, passedResult)
		t.Fatalf("GET passed result returned %d: %s", passedResult.StatusCode, body)
	}
	assertSafeStudentAssessmentPayload(t, readResponseBody(t, passedResult))

	if practiceScoped && (fixture.practiceAccess == nil || !fixture.practiceAccess.sawScope()) {
		t.Fatal("practice-task flow did not preserve scoped access context")
	}
}

type structuredSubmitResult struct {
	wikiSubmitResponse
	raw []byte
}

func startStructuredAttempt(t *testing.T, fixture integrationFixtures, url string, headers map[string]string) string {
	t.Helper()
	response := fixture.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, url, nil, headers)
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		body := readResponseBody(t, response)
		t.Fatalf("start returned %d: %s", response.StatusCode, body)
	}
	var started startTaskDTO
	decodeBody(t, response, &started)
	if started.AnswerID == "" || started.Status != "IN_PROCESS" || started.SandboxID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected structured assessment start: %+v", started)
	}
	return started.AnswerID
}

func submitStructuredAttempt(t *testing.T, fixture integrationFixtures, url string, payload json.RawMessage, headers map[string]string) structuredSubmitResult {
	t.Helper()
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]json.RawMessage{"answer_payload": payload})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal submit payload: %v", err)
	}
	response := fixture.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, url, bytes.NewReader(body), mergeHeaders(
		map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"},
		headers,
	))
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		responseBody := readResponseBody(t, response)
		t.Fatalf("submit returned %d: %s", response.StatusCode, responseBody)
	}
	responseBody := readResponseBody(t, response)
	var result wikiSubmitResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(responseBody, &result); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode submit response: %v body=%s", err, responseBody)
	}
	return structuredSubmitResult{wikiSubmitResponse: result, raw: responseBody}
}

func structuredAssessmentURLs(taskID string, practiceScoped bool) (string, string, func(string) string) {
	if !practiceScoped {
		taskURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s", apiPrefix, taskID)
		return taskURL, taskURL + "/start", func(answerID string) string {
			return fmt.Sprintf("%s/answers/%s/submit", taskURL, answerID)
		}
	}
	base := fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s/student/student-practice-tasks/%s/parts/%s/milestones/%s/lessons/%s/tasks/%s",
		apiPrefix,
		uuid.NewString(),
		uuid.NewString(),
		uuid.NewString(),
		uuid.NewString(),
		taskID,
	)
	return base, base + "/start", func(answerID string) string {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s/answers/%s/submit", base, answerID)
	}
}

func newStructuredFlowFixture(t *testing.T, task *answer.TaskMetadata, practiceScoped bool) structuredFlowFixture {
	t.Helper()
	transport := &structuredCourseTransport{task: task, token: "internal-token"}
	courseClient := courseclient.Client{
		BaseURL:       "http://course.test",
		InternalToken: transport.token,
		HTTPClient:    &http.Client{Transport: transport},
	}
	answers := newMemoryAnswerRepo()
	autoReviews := newMemoryAutoReviewRepo()
	manualReviews := newMemoryManualReviewRepo()
	selections := newMemoryAssessmentSelectionRepo()
	publisher := newRecordPublisher()
	progression := &answer.ProgressionService{TaskProvider: courseClient, Answers: answers}
	var practiceAccess *recordingPracticeAccess
	if practiceScoped {
		practiceAccess = &recordingPracticeAccess{}
		progression.PracticeTaskAccess = practiceAccess
	}

	getAnswer := answer.GetStudentAnswer{Answers: answers, AutoReviews: autoReviews, ManualReviews: manualReviews}
	start := answer.StartTaskAnswer{
		TaskProvider: courseClient,
		Answers:      answers,
		Publisher:    publisher,
		Progression:  progression,
	}
	finalValidation := answer.FinalValidation{
		Answers:         answers,
		TaskTestAnswers: selections,
		TaskProvider:    courseClient,
		Progression:     progression,
		Publisher:       publisher,
		AutoReviews:     autoReviews,
	}
	answerHandler := &handlers.AnswerHandler{
		Validator:  validator.New(),
		Start:      start,
		Progress:   progression,
		SubmitById: finalValidation,
		List:       answer.ListStudentAnswers{Answers: answers},
		Get:        getAnswer,
		ListResults: answer.ListStudentResults{
			Answers:      answers,
			TaskProvider: courseClient,
		},
		GetResult: answer.GetStudentResult{
			GetAnswer:    getAnswer,
			Answers:      answers,
			TaskProvider: courseClient,
		},
	}
	practiceHandler := &handlers.StudentPracticeTaskHandler{
		Validator:  validator.New(),
		Progress:   progression,
		Start:      start,
		SubmitById: finalValidation,
		Get:        getAnswer,
	}
	router := httpadapter.NewRouter(httpadapter.RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler:              answerHandler,
		StudentPracticeTaskHandler: practiceHandler,
		// This suite explicitly exercises the emergency compatibility flow; production defaults remain retired (410).
		LegacyPracticeWritesEnabled: true,
	})
	return structuredFlowFixture{
		integrationFixtures: integrationFixtures{
			Router:        router,
			Answers:       answers,
			AutoReviews:   autoReviews,
			ManualReviews: manualReviews,
			Publisher:     publisher,
		},
		selections:     selections,
		practiceAccess: practiceAccess,
	}
}

type memoryAssessmentSelectionRepo struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	records map[string][]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant
}

func newMemoryAssessmentSelectionRepo() *memoryAssessmentSelectionRepo {
	return &memoryAssessmentSelectionRepo{records: make(map[string][]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant)}
}

func (repo *memoryAssessmentSelectionRepo) ReplaceForAnswer(_ context.Context, answerID string, variants []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant) error {
	repo.mu.Lock()
	defer repo.mu.Unlock()
	repo.records[answerID] = append([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant(nil), variants...)
	return nil
}

func (repo *memoryAssessmentSelectionRepo) forAnswer(answerID string) []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant {
	repo.mu.Lock()
	defer repo.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant(nil), repo.records[answerID]...)
}

type recordingPracticeAccess struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	scopeWasSet bool
}

func (resolver *recordingPracticeAccess) ResolvePracticeTaskTaskAccess(ctx context.Context, _ string, taskID string) (*answer.TaskAccess, error) {
	resolver.recordScope(ctx)
	return &answer.TaskAccess{TaskID: taskID, Current: true}, nil
}

func (resolver *recordingPracticeAccess) ResolvePracticeTaskLessonAccess(ctx context.Context, _ string, lessonID string) (*answer.LessonAccess, error) {
	resolver.recordScope(ctx)
	return &answer.LessonAccess{LessonID: lessonID, Current: true}, nil
}

func (resolver *recordingPracticeAccess) recordScope(ctx context.Context) {
	resolver.mu.Lock()
	defer resolver.mu.Unlock()
	_, resolver.scopeWasSet = answer.PracticeTaskScopeFromContext(ctx)
}

func (resolver *recordingPracticeAccess) sawScope() bool {
	resolver.mu.Lock()
	defer resolver.mu.Unlock()
	return resolver.scopeWasSet
}

type structuredCourseTransport struct {
	task  *answer.TaskMetadata
	token string
}

func (transport *structuredCourseTransport) RoundTrip(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	publicTaskPath := fmt.Sprintf("/api/v1/task/get/%s", transport.task.ID)
	publicCoursePath := fmt.Sprintf("/api/v1/course/get/%s", transport.task.CourseID)
	taskPath := fmt.Sprintf("/internal/task/get-internal-task/%s", transport.task.ID)
	structurePath := fmt.Sprintf("/internal/course/get-internal-course-structure/%s", transport.task.CourseID)
	switch request.URL.Path {
	case publicTaskPath, publicCoursePath:
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "" {
			return structuredHTTPResponse(http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{"error": "public request used internal token"}), nil
		}
		return structuredHTTPResponse(http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"id": transport.task.ID}), nil
	case taskPath:
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != transport.token {
			return structuredHTTPResponse(http.StatusForbidden, map[string]string{"error": "forbidden"}), nil
		}
		return structuredHTTPResponse(http.StatusOK, structuredTaskContractPayload(transport.task)), nil
	case structurePath:
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != transport.token {
			return structuredHTTPResponse(http.StatusForbidden, map[string]string{"error": "forbidden"}), nil
		}
		return structuredHTTPResponse(http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
			"course_id": transport.task.CourseID,
			"lessons": []any{map[string]any{
				"id":        transport.task.LessonID,
				"course_id": transport.task.CourseID,
				"title":     "Lesson",
				"order":     1,
				"status":    domain.TaskStatusActive,
				"tasks": []any{map[string]any{
					"id":              transport.task.ID,
					"lesson_id":       transport.task.LessonID,
					"course_id":       transport.task.CourseID,
					"title":           transport.task.Title,
					"type":            transport.task.Type,
					"evaluation_mode": "AUTO",
					"order":           1,
					"status":          domain.TaskStatusActive,
				}},
			}},
		}), nil
	default:
		return structuredHTTPResponse(http.StatusNotFound, map[string]string{"error": "not found"}), nil
	}
}

func structuredTaskContractPayload(task *answer.TaskMetadata) map[string]any {
	tests := make([]any, 0, len(task.Tests))
	for _, question := range task.Tests {
		groups := make([]any, 0, len(question.Groups))
		for _, group := range question.Groups {
			groups = append(groups, map[string]any{
				"id": group.ID, "title": group.Title, "order": group.Order,
			})
		}
		variants := make([]any, 0, len(question.Variants))
		for _, variant := range question.Variants {
			variants = append(variants, map[string]any{
				"id":               variant.ID,
				"text":             variant.Text,
				"is_correct":       variant.IsCorrect,
				"correct_order":    variant.CorrectOrder,
				"group_id":         variant.GroupID,
				"group_source_key": variant.GroupSourceKey,
				"order":            variant.Order,
			})
		}
		tests = append(tests, map[string]any{
			"id":          question.ID,
			"kind":        question.Kind,
			"title":       question.Title,
			"description": question.Description,
			"order":       question.Order,
			"groups":      groups,
			"variants":    variants,
		})
	}
	return map[string]any{
		"id":                       task.ID,
		"lesson_id":                task.LessonID,
		"course_id":                task.CourseID,
		"title":                    task.Title,
		"description":              task.Description,
		"status":                   task.Status,
		"type":                     task.Type,
		"task_kind":                task.TaskKind,
		"code_structure_type_code": task.CodeStructureType,
		"allowed_errors_count":     task.AllowedErrorsCount,
		"tests":                    tests,
		"execution_mode":           "NO_RUN",
		"evaluation_mode":          "AUTO",
		"ui_mode":                  "QUIZ",
		"submission_mode":          "ANSWER_PAYLOAD",
		"requires_sandbox":         false,
		"max_attempts":             task.MaxAttempts,
	}
}

func structuredHTTPResponse(status int, payload any) *http.Response {
	body, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	return &http.Response{
		StatusCode: status,
		Header:     http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}},
		Body:       io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body)),
	}
}

func structuredAssessmentScenarios() []structuredAssessmentScenario {
	maxAttempts := 2
	newTask := func(taskType int16, taskKind, code string, question answer.TaskTestMetadata) *answer.TaskMetadata {
		return &answer.TaskMetadata{
			ID: uuid.NewString(), LessonID: uuid.NewString(), CourseID: uuid.NewString(),
			Title: "Assessment", Description: "Structured assessment",
			Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, Type: taskType, TaskKind: taskKind,
			CodeStructureType: code, AllowedErrorsCount: 0, Tests: []answer.TaskTestMetadata{question},
			ExecutionMode: "NO_RUN", EvaluationMode: "AUTO", UIMode: "QUIZ", SubmissionMode: "ANSWER_PAYLOAD",
			MaxAttempts: &maxAttempts,
		}
	}

	singleQuestionID := uuid.NewString()
	singleCorrectID := uuid.NewString()
	singleWrongID := uuid.NewString()
	singleTask := newTask(11, "test", "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC", answer.TaskTestMetadata{
		ID: singleQuestionID, Kind: "single_choice", Title: "Choose", Order: 1,
		Variants: []answer.TaskTestVariantMetadata{
			{ID: singleCorrectID, Text: "Correct", IsCorrect: true, Order: 1},
			{ID: singleWrongID, Text: "Wrong", Order: 2},
		},
	})

	orderingQuestionID := uuid.NewString()
	orderingAID := uuid.NewString()
	orderingBID := uuid.NewString()
	one, two := 1, 2
	orderingTask := newTask(12, "ordering", "TEST_ORDERING_BASIC", answer.TaskTestMetadata{
		ID: orderingQuestionID, Kind: "ordering", Title: "Arrange", Order: 1,
		Variants: []answer.TaskTestVariantMetadata{
			{ID: orderingAID, Text: "A", CorrectOrder: &two, Order: 1},
			{ID: orderingBID, Text: "B", CorrectOrder: &one, Order: 2},
		},
	})

	classificationQuestionID := uuid.NewString()
	classificationAID := uuid.NewString()
	classificationBID := uuid.NewString()
	groupAID := uuid.NewString()
	groupBID := uuid.NewString()
	classificationTask := newTask(13, "classification", "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_BASIC", answer.TaskTestMetadata{
		ID: classificationQuestionID, Kind: "classification", Title: "Classify", Order: 1,
		Groups: []answer.TaskTestGroupMetadata{
			{ID: groupAID, Title: "Group A", Order: 1},
			{ID: groupBID, Title: "Group B", Order: 2},
		},
		Variants: []answer.TaskTestVariantMetadata{
			{ID: classificationAID, Text: "A", GroupID: groupAID, GroupSourceKey: "group-a", Order: 1},
			{ID: classificationBID, Text: "B", GroupID: groupBID, GroupSourceKey: "group-b", Order: 2},
		},
	})

	return []structuredAssessmentScenario{
		{
			kind:             "single_choice",
			task:             singleTask,
			incorrectPayload: assessmentPayload(singleQuestionID, "variant_id", singleWrongID),
			correctPayload:   assessmentPayload(singleQuestionID, "variant_id", singleCorrectID),
		},
		{
			kind:             "ordering",
			task:             orderingTask,
			incorrectPayload: assessmentPayload(orderingQuestionID, "ordered_variant_ids", []string{orderingAID, orderingBID}),
			correctPayload:   assessmentPayload(orderingQuestionID, "ordered_variant_ids", []string{orderingBID, orderingAID}),
		},
		{
			kind: "classification",
			task: classificationTask,
			incorrectPayload: assessmentPayload(classificationQuestionID, "group_assignments", []map[string]string{
				{"variant_id": classificationAID, "group_id": groupBID},
				{"variant_id": classificationBID, "group_id": groupBID},
			}),
			correctPayload: assessmentPayload(classificationQuestionID, "group_assignments", []map[string]string{
				{"variant_id": classificationAID, "group_id": groupAID},
				{"variant_id": classificationBID, "group_id": groupBID},
			}),
		},
	}
}

func assessmentPayload(questionID, field string, value any) json.RawMessage {
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"answers": []any{map[string]any{"test_id": questionID, field: value}},
	})
	return payload
}

func assertPersistedAssessmentSelections(t *testing.T, kind string, selections []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, allCorrect bool) {
	t.Helper()
	wantCount := 2
	if kind == "single_choice" {
		wantCount = 1
	}
	if len(selections) != wantCount {
		t.Fatalf("persisted %s selections = %d, want %d: %+v", kind, len(selections), wantCount, selections)
	}
	for index, selection := range selections {
		switch kind {
		case "single_choice":
			if selection.SubmittedOrder != nil || selection.SubmittedGroupID != nil {
				t.Fatalf("single-choice persistence contains structured fields: %+v", selection)
			}
		case "ordering":
			if selection.SubmittedOrder == nil || *selection.SubmittedOrder != index+1 || selection.SubmittedGroupID != nil {
				t.Fatalf("ordering persistence mismatch: %+v", selections)
			}
		case "classification":
			if selection.SubmittedGroupID == nil || selection.SubmittedOrder != nil {
				t.Fatalf("classification persistence mismatch: %+v", selections)
			}
		}
		if allCorrect && !selection.IsCorrect {
			t.Fatalf("correct %s answer persisted an incorrect row: %+v", kind, selections)
		}
	}
}

func assertPublicAssessmentHasNoAnswerKey(t *testing.T, payload []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, forbidden := range []string{`"is_correct"`, `"correct_order"`, `"group_id"`, `"group_source_key"`} {
		if bytes.Contains(payload, []byte(forbidden)) {
			t.Fatalf("public task exposes %s: %s", forbidden, payload)
		}
	}
}

func assertSafeStudentAssessmentPayload(t *testing.T, payload []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, forbidden := range []string{
		`"items"`,
		`"correct":`,
		"correct_answers",
		"incorrect_answers",
		"correct_variant_id",
		"correct_variant_text",
		"correct_order",
		"correct_group",
		"expected_group",
		"group_source_key",
		"submitted_variant_ids",
		"submitted_group_assignments",
		"selected_variant_id",
		"TEST_VARIANT_INCORRECT",
		"TEST_ORDER_INCORRECT",
		"TEST_CLASSIFICATION_INCORRECT",
	} {
		if strings.Contains(string(payload), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("student result exposes %q: %s", forbidden, payload)
		}
	}
}

func readResponseBody(t *testing.T, response *http.Response) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	defer response.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read response body: %v", err)
	}
	return body
}
